home.subheadlineLine1: Job Search Bridge searches, filters and tailors your CV for you.
home.subheadlineLine2: You stay focused on what really matters:
home.founderQuote: I built this because I was job hunting myself. I saved listings by hand, fed them one by one to an AI to see if they made sense for my profile: most didn't. The good ones I adapted with prompt after prompt, never quite getting the format I wanted. And more than once, by the time I was ready to apply, the listing was already gone. Job Search Bridge does that part for you, start to finish, so you never lose an opportunity to the fatigue of endless scrolling.
home.founderSectionHeading: Why we built Job Search Bridge
home.pillar1Desc: Score A+B filters out the noise before you waste time reading it
home.pillar2Desc: A ready .docx for every offer, in Italian or English
home.pillar3Title: Everything in one place, stay focused on what matters
home.pillar3Desc: Job Search Bridge never posts activity on your profiles and never sends applications without your consent
home.step1Title: Upload your CV and set up your search
home.step1Desc: Upload your CV, tell us where and how you want to work (area, salary, work mode), pick the CV style you prefer.
home.step2Title: Start the search whenever you want.
home.step2Desc: One click on "Start search" and Job Search Bridge looks for offers in your area, comparing them against your real CV. Off-target ones you never even see: only offers that fit arrive, with the reasoning behind the score.
home.step3Title: Adapt your CV with one click.
home.step3Desc: For the offers you're interested in, click "Adapt CV": it gets rewritten specifically for that role, automatically in the listing's language: Italian or English.
home.step4Title: Track your application to the end.
home.step4Desc: The tracker lets you follow every application from submission, through the interview, to the offer or rejection. The rest (the interview) is up to you.
home.competitorIntro: It's not an auto-apply bot: these products send applications automatically, often in violation of LinkedIn's Terms of Service, risking generic applications that don't reflect the specific role. Job Search Bridge never sends anything without an explicit click from you.
home.competitorSubhead: We don't fire off applications for you. We give you the right CV for the right offer: you decide what to send.
